text: The Lord is with me, and I am going up to possess my victory.
bibleVerseText: The Lord was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country.

text: I am a mighty warrior, and the Lord is with me.
bibleVerseText: The angel of the Lord appeared to Gideon and said, 'The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.'

text: I go in the strength I have, and I am the one God is sending to save.
bibleVerseText: Go in the strength you have... Am I not sending you?

text: I am not defined by my background; I am defined by God's call on my life.
bibleVerseText: Pardon me, my lord... but my clan is the weakest... and I am the least in my family.

text: I have peace because the Lord is my peace.
bibleVerseText: So Gideon built an altar to the Lord there and called it The Lord Is Peace.

text: The Spirit of the Lord clothes me with power to lead and to win.
bibleVerseText: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet.

text: I am chosen because I am alert, prepared, and ready for the task.
bibleVerseText: The Lord said to Gideon, 'There are still too many people... I will sift them for you there.'

text: The sword of the Lord is working on my behalf to defeat every adversary.
bibleVerseText: A sword for the Lord and for Gideon!

text: God empowers me to pursue with strength, and I finish every mission in victory.
bibleVerseText: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit.

text: The Lord is my King and He is the one who rules over my life.
bibleVerseText: I will not rule over you... the Lord will rule over you.

text: I am a person of honor, and I stand tall even in difficult times.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord came on him, and he led Israel.

text: I am like the sun when it rises in its strength, shining brighter and brighter.
bibleVerseText: But may all who love you be like the sun when it rises in its strength.

text: I am a mother/father in my generation, bringing life and wisdom to those around me.
bibleVerseText: Until I, Deborah, arose, arose a mother in Israel.

text: My heart is with the willing people who offer themselves to God's work.
bibleVerseText: My heart is with Israel's princes, with the willing volunteers among the people.

text: Even the stars in their courses fight for me against my enemies.
bibleVerseText: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

text: I am set apart from the womb for a special work of God.
bibleVerseText: The boy is to be a Nazirite, dedicated to God from the womb.

text: The Spirit of the Lord begins to stir me and move me toward my purpose.
bibleVerseText: And the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him.

text: I have supernatural strength to tear down every lion that tries to stop me.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him so that he tore the lion apart.

text: Out of the eater comes something to eat, and out of the strong comes something sweet.
bibleVerseText: Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet.

text: I am breaking every bond and cord that tries to hold me back.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax.

text: I am refreshed by the stream of water that God provides for my thirst.
bibleVerseText: God opened up the hollow place... and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned.

text: I am waking up and shaking off the enemy's attempts to bind me.
bibleVerseText: He awoke from his sleep and thought, 'I'll go out as before and shake myself free.'

text: God remembers me and gives me the strength I need one more time.
bibleVerseText: Sovereign Lord, remember me. Please, God, strengthen me just once more.

text: I am finishing my mission with more impact than I started with.
bibleVerseText: Thus he killed many more when he died than while he lived.

text: I choose to do what is right in the eyes of God above all else.
bibleVerseText: In those days... everyone did as they saw fit.

text: I am a person of loyalty, and I am committed to the path God has set before me.
bibleVerseText: Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay.

text: The Lord is my God and His people are my people.
bibleVerseText: Your people will be my people and your God my God.

text: I find favor in the eyes of those who can help me fulfill my destiny.
bibleVerseText: May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord.

text: I am working in a field of favor where I am protected and provided for.
bibleVerseText: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished.

text: The Lord is repaying me for all the good I have done for others.
bibleVerseText: May the Lord repay you for what you have done.

text: I receive a full reward from the Lord under whose wings I have taken refuge.
bibleVerseText: May you be richly rewarded by the Lord... under whose wings you have come to take refuge.

text: I am a person of noble character, and everyone in my city knows it.
bibleVerseText: All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.

text: I wait patiently because the Lord is working out every detail of my life.
bibleVerseText: Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today.

text: My Redeemer is active and He is restoring everything I thought was lost.
bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer.

text: My life is being renewed and I am sustained in my later years by God's goodness.
bibleVerseText: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age.

text: I am part of a lineage of blessing that will impact generations to come.
bibleVerseText: Then Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife... and she gave birth to a son.

text: God is turning my bitterness into sweetness and my emptiness into fullness.
bibleVerseText: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty... [but later] the women said to Naomi: 'Praise be to the Lord!'

text: I have more than enough because I walk in the favor of the harvest.
bibleVerseText: So she gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.

text: I am kind to those who have suffered, and God is kind to me in return.
bibleVerseText: May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.

text: I am not alone; God provides companions who love and support me.
bibleVerseText: Your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons.

text: I am a restorer of hope, life, and blessing in my family.
bibleVerseText: The women living there said, 'Naomi has a son!' And they named him Obed.

text: I walk in divine timing and find myself in the right place at the right time.
bibleVerseText: As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz.

text: God blesses me with rich spiritual and physical inheritance in every season.
bibleVerseText: Boaz replied, 'I have been told all about what you have done...'

text: I am humble and God exalts me in due time.
bibleVerseText: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground.

text: My reputation precedes me as a person of integrity and hard work.
bibleVerseText: She has been at it from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter.

text: I am a blessing to my elders and a joy to my community.
bibleVerseText: The women said to Naomi: 'Praise be to the Lord, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer.'

text: God uses my ordinary days to accomplish His extraordinary plans.
bibleVerseText: Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.

text: I am covered by the garment of God's protection.
bibleVerseText: Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer.

text: I do not let fear stop me from choosing what is right.
bibleVerseText: But Ruth replied, 'Don't urge me to leave you or to turn back from you.'

text: I live in the deep, loyal covenant love of God that never fails.
bibleVerseText: The Lord bless him! He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead.

text: I am a person of prayer, and the Lord remembers and answers my petitions.
bibleVerseText: So in due time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, 'Because I asked the Lord for him.'

text: My heart rejoices in the Lord, and my strength is exalted in Him.
bibleVerseText: My heart rejoices in the Lord; in the Lord my horn is lifted high.

text: There is no one holy like the Lord, and there is no Rock like my God.
bibleVerseText: There is no one holy like the Lord; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

text: The Lord is a God who knows everything, and by Him my actions are weighed.
bibleVerseText: For the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.

text: I am raised up from the dust to sit with princes and inherit a throne of honor.
bibleVerseText: He raises the poor from the dust... to seat them with princes.

text: It is not by my own strength that I prevail, but by the power of God.
bibleVerseText: It is not by strength that one prevails.

text: I am growing in stature and in favor with both the Lord and people.
bibleVerseText: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.

text: I have ears to hear what the Spirit is saying; Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening.
bibleVerseText: Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening.

text: Not one of the words God speaks over my life will fall to the ground.
bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel's words fall to the ground.

text: I serve the Lord with all my heart and I put away all distractions.
bibleVerseText: Commit yourselves to the Lord and serve him only.

text: Ebenezer! Thus far the Lord has helped me.
bibleVerseText: He named it Ebenezer, saying, 'Thus far the Lord has helped us.'

text: I am anointed by God for a specific task and His Spirit is changing me into a different person.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord will come powerfully upon you... and you will be changed into a different person.

text: I do what my hand finds to do, for God is with me.
bibleVerseText: Do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.

text: God is giving me a new heart to fulfill His will.
bibleVerseText: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul's heart.

text: I am not afraid. The Lord does not reject me for His great name's sake.
bibleVerseText: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people.

text: Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few.
bibleVerseText: Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few.

text: I value obedience over sacrifice and I listen to the voice of God.
bibleVerseText: To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

text: I am not judged by my outward appearance; God looks at my heart.
bibleVerseText: People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

text: I am anointed and the Spirit of the Lord rests powerfully upon me.
bibleVerseText: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him... and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David.

text: I come against every giant in the name of the Lord of Hosts.
bibleVerseText: You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty.

text: The battle is the Lord's and He gives me the victory.
bibleVerseText: For the battle is the Lord's, and he will give all of you into our hands.

text: I walk wisely in all my ways, and the Lord is with me.
bibleVerseText: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.

text: I find strength and encouragement in the Lord my God.
bibleVerseText: But David found strength in the Lord his God.

text: I pursue, I overtake, and I recover all that the enemy has stolen.
bibleVerseText: Pursue them... You will certainly overtake them and succeed in the rescue.

text: God is my reliable helper in times of trouble.
bibleVerseText: Then Samuel took a stone... and called its name Ebenezer.

text: The Lord is establishing me and exalting my position for the sake of His people.
bibleVerseText: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom.

text: I am becoming stronger and stronger because the Lord God of Hosts is with me.
bibleVerseText: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord, the God of hosts, was with him.

text: The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like a bursting flood.
bibleVerseText: The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like the bursting out of waters.

text: I celebrate before the Lord with all my might and with songs of joy.
bibleVerseText: David and all Israel were celebrating with all their might before the Lord.

text: I am unafraid to be radical in my worship of the Lord.
bibleVerseText: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes.

text: How great You are, Sovereign Lord! There is no one like You.
bibleVerseText: How great you are, Sovereign Lord! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you.

text: God is building a house for me and establishing my legacy forever.
bibleVerseText: The Lord himself will establish a house for you.

text: I am confident that what God has promised concerning me will be done.
bibleVerseText: And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house.

text: I receive God's kindness even in my most forgotten and barren seasons.
bibleVerseText: Is there no one still left... to whom I can show God's kindness?

text: I eat at the King's table continually as one of His own children.
bibleVerseText: So Mephibosheth ate at David's table like one of the king's sons.

text: I am courageous and I stand boldly for my people and the cities of my God.
bibleVerseText: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God.

text: I am a person after God's own heart, quick to repent and seek His face.
bibleVerseText: Then David said to Nathan, 'I have sinned against the Lord.'

text: God creates a way to bring me close — I am never too far from His presence.
bibleVerseText: God does not take away life; instead, he devises ways so that a banished person does not remain banished from him.

text: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer.

text: In my distress I called to the Lord, and He heard my voice from His temple.
bibleVerseText: In my distress I called to the Lord... From his temple he heard my voice.

text: The Lord is my lamp; He turns my darkness into light.
bibleVerseText: You, Lord, are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.

text: With God's help I can advance against a troop and scale a wall.
bibleVerseText: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

text: God's way is perfect; the Lord's word is flawless.
bibleVerseText: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord's word is flawless.

text: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
bibleVerseText: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

text: God makes my feet like the feet of a deer and enables me to stand on the heights.
bibleVerseText: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

text: The Lord's gentleness has made me great, and His grace lifts me higher every day.
bibleVerseText: You make your saving help my shield; your gentleness has made me great.

text: The Lord lives and is praised forever — He is my Rock, my Savior, and my song.
bibleVerseText: The Lord lives! Praised be my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!

text: The Spirit of the Lord speaks through me and His word is on my tongue.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

text: I am part of an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things and secure.
bibleVerseText: Has he not made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part?

text: I do not offer to the Lord that which costs me nothing.
bibleVerseText: I will not sacrifice to the Lord my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing.
